parameters.name: arg
parameters.meaning: Raw handler argument byte from the command header. It is printed only when it differs from the value the named fields already imply, so seeing it means the command uses an unusual argument encoding.

parameters.name: character
parameters.meaning: The packed 32-bit character selector word. Its low half is the character id and byte 2 is a secondary class/variant input; see `character_number` and `character_variant`.

parameters.name: character_number
parameters.meaning: Low 16 bits of the character selector: the character/actor id.

parameters.name: character_type
parameters.meaning: Byte 2 of the character selector, where the handler treats it as a type selector rather than a variant.

parameters.name: entry_byte3
parameters.meaning: Byte 2 of `entry_word1`; record +0x0E.

parameters.name: entry_half0
parameters.meaning: Low half of `entry_word0`; record +0x08.

parameters.name: entry_half1
parameters.meaning: High half of `entry_word0`; record +0x0A, read back as a signed value.

parameters.name: entry_half2
parameters.meaning: Low half of `entry_word1`; record +0x0C.

parameters.name: entry_word0
parameters.meaning: First payload word of the battle order (RADI_BTL_ORDER): its low half lands at record +0x08 and its high half at +0x0A, which the battle character reads back as a signed value.

parameters.name: entry_word1
parameters.meaning: Second payload word: low half to record +0x0C, byte 2 to +0x0E, byte 3 to +0x0F.

parameters.name: entry_word2_high
parameters.meaning: The upper three bytes of the third payload word, which have no reader specific enough to name yet.

parameters.name: explicit_char
parameters.meaning: `1` when the command carries its own character selector word, `0` when it acts on the script's current character. It corresponds to bit 0 of the handler argument and decides whether a `character=` word is present.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.meaning: Command header flag byte. Bit 0x80 is the keep-going bit: set (the hidden default), the next command runs in the same frame; clear (printed as `yield=1`), the script pauses until the next game update. Other bits are rare and stay as an explicit flags= byte.

parameters.name: leader
parameters.meaning: Whether this character leads its team. It is bits 4-7 of record +0x10, which `CBtlCharacter::ChangeLeader` extracts and tests for non-zero.

parameters.name: team
parameters.meaning: Which side this character fights on. It is the low nibble of record +0x10, which `CBtlCharacter::ChangeTeamID` reads with `& 0x0F`. Shipped battles use 0 and 1.

parameters.name: words
parameters.meaning: Raw fallback payload, used when a command shape has no named form yet.

parameters.name: yield
parameters.meaning: Pause the script here for one game frame; the next command runs on the following update. Lines without it keep running immediately.
